items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Erskine Tate was a leader of the famous Vendome Orchestra and he was the stepson of my music teacher, W. L. Jackson.

ctx.x: Maybe you'd like to tell us just a little bit about him.
W.L. Jackson was a great talker. He used to claim to be one of the best violinists in the country, and after I had my lesson every night he would sit down and just talk about his experiences.
